verdict.rationale: pnpm is an official CLI that installs non-interactively in automation. It auto-switches to frozen-lockfile mode in CI, and installs fail in several documented cases: a stale lockfile in CI, packages missing in offline/store-only mode, or an unsatisfiable workspace: version. A dry-run reports what an install would change without writing anything, which suits agent planning. Missing for 10: explicit exit-code documentation, a documented non-interactive update/upgrade command flow, evidence on error-message clarity or machine-readable error output, and hands-on agent corroboration (one community note calls failures hard to debug).
